title: District Court Rennovation
description: District Court Renovation — a heritage restoration project preserving the dignity and timeless character of a historic stone building.
notes: he District Court Renovation project honors the architectural legacy of a colonial-era stone structure, carefully restoring its original proportions, textures, and spatial charm. With its sloping tiled roof, arched windows, and thick masonry walls, the building embodies strength and simplicity. The restoration approach focused on structural conservation, material authenticity, and improved usability while respecting its heritage essence. Thoughtfully integrated services and subtle landscape interventions revive the court’s functional efficiency without compromising its historical identity — a fine balance between preservation and modern adaptation.
